title: Professional teeth cleaning
what: A dental hygienist removes tartar and plaque with ultrasound and special brushes. Your teeth become smooth and clean.
why: Usually every 6 to 12 months for prevention; before treatment, implants, or braces; or for bleeding gums.
tell_doctor: If your gums bleed or your teeth are sensitive

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat beforehand. After cleaning, you are sometimes advised not to eat or drink anything that stains for 1 to 2 hours.

steps: The dentist checks your teeth and gums
Plaque is removed with an air and powder spray
The teeth are polished with paste
Sometimes a fluoride product is put on the teeth
You are shown how to care for your teeth at home
feel: Vibration and water in your mouth
Sensitive teeth may ache. Speak up, and the hygienist will lower the power or numb the area
Your gums may bleed a little
after: For 1 to 2 hours, do not eat or drink anything that stains: coffee, tea, or wine
For a few days, your teeth may be sensitive to cold
Brush twice a day and use floss

faq.a: No. Professional cleaning does not harm the enamel. It removes what a toothbrush cannot at home.

faq.q: Why do my gums bleed after cleaning?
faq.a: The gums were inflamed because of the tartar. After cleaning, they usually heal in a few days.

reminders.text: Teeth cleaning soon. Brush your teeth and eat beforehand.
